silhouette.reason: Single-sheathed USRA boxcar from every side: Howe-truss bracing, running board with laterals, sliding door on its track, Andrews-style trucks, brake staff and wheel at the B end.
fixes: thicker brake staff and a spoked brake wheel so the B end reads in the FRONT view

proportions.reason: 13.4 × 3.0 × 4.1 m; body length, wheel size, wheelbase, door width and wheel spacing pass the ±2% measures; panel count each side of the door matches the builder photo.
fixes: check truck side-frame spacing against the FRONT view of the builder photo

materials.reason: Painted wood siding, steel framing and ends, weathered-wood running board, cast-iron trucks. The road name (CLINCHFIELD) is still broken by the diagonal braces' parallax at 3/4 in hero.png, and the running board renders near-white in sheet.png.
fixes: flush-mount the stencil pieces or taper the brace faces so the road name reads at 3/4
darken the running-board wood to a grey-brown weathered value
planar-map the wheel faces instead of lathe UVs

detail.reason: Board-level siding, bolted bracing, door straps and handle, door track, couplers with uncoupling lever and air hose, ladders and stirrups, brake rigging. Missing journal-box lids, door hasp/seal pin, roof seam caps.
fixes: door hasp, seal pin and door stops

wear.reason: The hero reads as a freshly painted car: the siding red is even, the grime gradient from the rails and the rust streaks under the rivets are too faint to see at hero distance; only the underframe is dark.
fixes: stronger road grime rising from the sill (double the grime strength below 1 m)
a few replaced boards in fresher paint and chalk car-card marks by the door
longer, wider rust streaks under the door track

lod.reason: LOD2 (1.2k) keeps the box, roof walk, trucks and the road name, but drops all the Howe-truss bracing and the door outline, which are the biggest graphic marks on the side at mid distance.
fixes: bake the brace pattern and the door outline into LOD2 vertex colour

technical.reason: QA PASS; ~25.5k / ~9.2k / 1.2–1.3k triangles; one material; 13 / 11 / 11 draws for the moving pivots; switchable liveries via paint slots.
fixes: trim LOD0 by sharing one tessellated board panel per side
